programme.desc: Un carismático criminal recluta a un equipo de expertos ladrones para llevar a cabo un gran asalto en Las Vegas.
programme.title: Ocean's Eleven

programme.desc: Danny Ocean y su equipo de criminales planean un elaborado robo en Europa para saldar una deuda con el jefe de un casino.
programme.title: Ocean's Twelve

programme.desc: Danny Ocean vuelve a reunir a los chicos para un nuevo golpe, después de que Willy Bank, el despiadado dueño de un casino, traicione a Reuben Tishkoff, amigo y mentor de Danny.
programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen

programme.desc: La historia de Johnny Cash, quien forma una unión estable con June Carter y lucha contra su adicción a las drogas camino al estrellato.
programme.title: Walk the Line

programme.desc: Una pareja adicta al trabajo decide tomarse unas vacaciones buceando en las Bahamas. Sin embargo, la lancha que los lleva al medio de la mar los abandona en unas aguas infestadas de tiburones.
programme.title: Open Water

programme.desc: Jonás Taylor lidera un equipo de investigación en las profundidades del océano. Acorralados por colosales tiburones prehistóricos y despiadados bandidos, los científicos intentan sobrevivir a toda costa.
programme.title: Meg 2: The Trench

programme.desc: Mina, una artista de 28 años se queda varada en un extenso bosque virgen del oeste de Irlanda. Al encontrar refugio, se ve atrapada junto a tres desconocidos, donde cada noche los acechan unas misteriosas criaturas.
programme.title: The Watchers

programme.desc: John McClane viaja a Rusia en busca de su hijo y descubre que es un agente de la CIA con una misión. Ambos deben superar sus diferencias para proteger a un testigo y evitar una catástrofe.
programme.title: A Good Day to Die Hard

programme.desc: Un grupo de ex soldados y un biólogo se enfrentarán a los cazadores más letales de todo el universo, quienes han alterado sus cuerpos con el ADN de otras especies para hacer desaparecer a la raza humana.
programme.title: The Predator

programme.desc: Faith, Brit, Cotty y Candy son cuatro jóvenes estudiantes dispuestas a llegar al extremo con tal de conseguir dinero para emprender lo que se presenta como el viaje de sus vidas durante las vacaciones de primavera.
programme.title: Spring Breakers

programme.desc: Una odisea inesperada se desarrolla después de que el hermano de un cineasta empieza a recibir las pinturas de una supuesta niña de ocho años.
programme.title: Catfish

programme.desc: Recientemente liberado de prisión, un miembro de una pandilla se ve obligado por sus líderes a orquestar un crimen con una pandilla rival.
programme.title: Shot Caller

programme.desc: Al mudarse de Montana, un joven y sus amigos en Florida enfrentan a políticos y urbanizadores por la protección de búhos en extinción.
programme.title: Hoot

programme.desc: Armado únicamente con muchos sueños y ganas de aventura, el joven chocolatero Willy Wonka conoce a los Oompa Loompas y se dispone a cambiar el mundo.
programme.title: Wonka

programme.desc: Un grupo de amigos que se reúne una vez a la semana para jugar cambia su rutina y decide resolver un falso asesinato, pero, a medida que la partida avanza, se dan cuenta de que esta vez lo que está ocurriendo es real.
programme.title: Game Night

programme.desc: Confinado a un pulmón de acero, el escritor Mark O'Brien consulta a una terapeuta sexual para perder su virginidad.

programme.desc: The Alaskan Oil Pipeline In 1973, a desperate America, starved by an OPEC embargo, began construction on a 800-mile lifeline for its insatiable oil hunger. We'll study the technological triumph of the Alaskan oil pipeline built over impenetrable mountains and tundra, where temperatures drop to 75 below zero, and its impact on a fragile ecological system.
programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.desc: The Next Nostradamus Two men sharing startling visions of the future possess distinctly different backgrounds: Michel de Nostradamus was a French apothecary and healer in the 16th century; he would become the most famous seer in history. His 21st century counterpart is Dr. Bruce Bueno de Mesquita, a renowned political scientist who teaches game theory at New York University and Stanford. While Nostradamus looked to the stars and mysticism to divine his apocalyptic revelations, Dr. Bueno de Mesquita relies on the most omnipotent tool ever designed by man to predict future events: the computer. This special explores not only the commonalities of these men's visions about World War III, famine, and the coming of the Anti-Christ, but it also traces the evolution from mysticism to hard math, and determines whether science has always existed in prophecy, manifesting itself in different forms through the ages.
programme.title: Story Feature

programme.desc: Prophets of Doom Today's world has troubles unique to its time in history, from the global financial crisis to technological meltdowns to full scale, computerized global war. Observing the convergence of such events, contemporary prophets have begun to emerge from obscurity to suggest that these conditions might be signs of the demise of the modern world.
programme.title: Story Feature

programme.desc: Maya Messengers December 21, 2012: a prophetic date delivered in stone by the ancient Maya. Revered by scientists for their extremely accurate calendars, the Maya are also known for their mysterious ability to predict unsettling events, so many are taking the December date seriously. On this date a rare galactic alignment will take place and coincidentally, as the alignment happens, our sun will be entering its most violent solar storm cycle. And, all of this comes at a time when scientists believe Earth's magnetic defense shield, which protects us from dangerous solar radiation, may be compromised. Our planet may become paralyzed. People are heeding the warning and getting prepared, including a group of everyday Americans learning how to fend for themselves and live off the grid.
programme.title: Countdown to Apocalypse

programme.desc: Hopi Blue Star The Hopi people have warned us that the world is headed for extinction. Based in the Arizona Desert, the Native American tribe of the Hopi has been prophesying about the fate of society for centuries. They have accurately predicted the coming of the settlers to their land, the birth of telecommunication, and the worldwide spread of the internet. The Hopi believe that our actions have caused the earth to become out of balance which will lead to a cataclysmic great purification of the planet that few will survive. To herald these end times, the Hopi believe that a blue star will arise in the heavens, followed by a great shaking of the earth. These prophecies have been passed down from generation to generation and warn of massive earthquakes, tsunamis, and super-volcanos that threaten the lives of millions. The Foster family of Illinois is prepping in their own way to be ready for the end.
programme.title: Countdown to Apocalypse

programme.desc: Prophets of Doom Nostradamus, regarded as the most well-known prophet in the history, wasn't alone. Edgar Cayce, America's most famous psychic, predicted the 1929 stock market crash and the coming of World War II. Joseph Smith, the founder of the Mormon religion, claimed to receive messages directly from God foretelling terrors of a corrupted government and an impending bloody civil war. St. Malachy predicted that the next pope would signal a time of great tribulation and ultimately, the end of the world. Isaac Newton determined when the horrors depicted in the Book of Revelations would come to pass. Web Bot, a computer program, predicted global catastrophes such as September 11. Web Bot's data is warning of the end of world around December 2012. Hugh Vail is prepping his family for apocalyptic scenarios and helping others through the American Preppers Network.
programme.title: Countdown to Apocalypse

programme.desc: Future Terrors Nightmarish terrors long relegated to the pages of science fiction are threatening to become a reality in the 21st Century. As science continues to evolve, the boundaries of fantasy and reality have blurred as we uncover new truths about our world and beyond. This countdown to future Apocalypse has lead everyday people to prepare for survival in the face of the looming Doomsday. Utah housewife Peggy Layton has stored years worth of food in an underground shelter and zombie researcher Matt Mogk has developed his own survival plan including a stockpile of weapons specifically chosen to fend off a zombie attack.
programme.title: Countdown to Apocalypse

programme.desc: Using Your Credit, Crazy or Compelling Don’t live on borrowed time. Join the Biz Kids, and you’ll see the true cost of purchasing with credit. Meet entrepreneurs who have successfully navigated credit pitfalls.

programme.desc: Geronimo: The Last Renegade Story of the great Apache guerrilla warrior Goyathlay, called by the Mexicans, "Geronimo." Forced off his Arizona land by government authorities in 1876, the embittered Geronimo launches a series of bloody raids against white settlers.
programme.title: Biography

programme.desc: Crazy Horse: The Last Warrior Story of the great chief of the Oglala Sioux who helped defeat General Custer at Little Bighorn. Crazy Horse fought all his life to protect Indian lands and treaty rights, and defeated General George Crook at the Battle of the Rosebud just eight days before his encounter with Custer.
programme.title: Biography

programme.desc: Sitting Bull: Chief of the Lakota Nation Profile of the great Sioux warrior and mystic medicine man who led his people in a bloody struggle for survival against the encroachment of the white man's "civilization." Includes the story of his victory over Custer at Little Bighorn.
programme.title: Biography

programme.desc: The James Gang Profile of brothers Jesse and Frank James, who led a gang of killers and thieves who terrorized the Midwest. This documentary debunks the myth that Jesse was a frontier Robin Hood--he stole from anyone and killed those who got in his way.
programme.title: Biography

programme.desc: Earp Brothers: The Lawmen of the West Story of the controversial frontier lawmen. Follow the violent trail from Dodge City and Tombstone to the famous shootout at the OK Corral.
programme.title: Biography

programme.desc: Pocahontas Story of the American Indian princess who risked her life to save English explorer John Smith. This profile goes beyond the myths we learned in childhood to chronicle the life of the real Pocahontas: a Native American stateswoman who dreamed of peaceful coexistence with the European settlers.
programme.title: Biography

programme.desc: Pancho Villa Profile of the controversial Mexican revolutionary who was the only foreign military leader to attack American soil since 1812. Features the story of General John J. Pershing's expedition to capture Villa that ended in failure.

programme.desc: Halt U-Boats in Zeebrugge In April 1918, a flotilla of British warships set sail from Dover bound for the port of Zeebrugge on the German-occupied Belgian coast. Their mission--to prevent German U-boats stationed there from entering the North Sea and Atlantic. Led by the cruiser HMS Vindictive, the ships headed across the English Channel, including two old ferries to be sunk at the harbor entrances. The battle that ensued proved costly with 200 British fatalities and 8 Victoria Crosses awarded for the night's action.
programme.title: History's Raiders

programme.desc: Target St. Nazaire March 27, 1942, British Commandos raided the German-occupied port of St. Nazaire.
programme.title: History's Raiders

programme.desc: The Dambusters On May 15, 1943, 19 Lancaster bombers set off for Germany's industrial heartland.
programme.title: History's Raiders

programme.desc: The Schweinfurt Disaster On August 17, 1943, the 8th U.S. Army Air Force launched its first major long-range bombing raids into Nazi Germany's heartland targeting the industrial towns of Regensburg and Schweinfurt.
programme.title: History's Raiders

programme.desc: Free Cabanatuan In January 1945, as the U.S. armed forces inched forward in a savage campaign to liberate the Philippine Islands from the Japanese, men of the 6th Ranger Battalion set off on a raid deep behind enemy lines. It was one of the most dramatic missions they ever undertook--to rescue more than 500 Americans held in the Cabanatuan POW camp. Speaking of the raid on the death camp, General MacArthur said: "No incident of the campaign in the Pacific has given me such satisfaction.
programme.title: History's Raiders

programme.desc: The SAS Siege on the Embassy On May 6, 1980, astonished British TV viewers watched as 26 hostages were freed.
programme.title: History's Raiders

programme.desc: The Falklands Campaign The 1982 Falklands War witnessed the largest deployment of British Army Special Forces since WWII--the Special Air Service, the Special Boat Squadron, and the Royal Marines Mountain and Arctic Warfare Cadre conducted several spectacular raids during the war. One of the most successful, the attack by the D Squadron SAS against an Argentinean airfield on Pebble Island, proved the SAS motto--Who Dares Wins. But the war cost heavily on both sides--255 British and over 1,000 Argentineans died.
programme.title: History's Raiders

programme.desc: Search & Rescue in the Balkans In June 1995, two U.S. Air Force F-16 fighter-bombers were enforcing the U.N. no-fly zone over Bosnia when they were engaged by Surface to Air Missiles from Serbian territory.
programme.title: History's Raiders

programme.desc: Vietnam The John Walker & Sons Voyager sails into Halong Bay, Vietnam. From there, host-photographer Scott Woodward travels to the capital, Hanoi, to meet one of the Vietnam's four divas, My Linh. As Vietnam's music ambassador, My Linh's amazing voice has captivated hearts around the world. 2012 marked My Linh's 20th anniversary as an artist and performer - and appropriately, Scott recounts her remarkable life and musical milestones with his camera. From the old neighborhoods of Hanoi to its idyllic countryside and inside its majestic Opera House, My Linh shares her life and world with Scott in an intimate and dramatic fashion.
programme.title: Around the World With Voyager

programme.desc: Hong Kong Scott Woodward meets Stephen Fung Tak Lun, one of Asia's most versatile talents. From acting to directing and music, Stephen has done it all. Scott's mission will be to shoot 5 definitive portraits of Stephen around Hong Kong, capturing his rise through the territory's iconic entertainment industry. As Scott documents Stephen's story on film, he gathers insights on his passion for filmmaking; and how the man transformed himself from an aspiring rock guitarist into a director. Now, he's set on changing the face of Asian cinema for larger audiences.
programme.title: Around the World With Voyager

programme.desc: Manila Host and photographer Scott Woodward photographs filmmaker Brillante Mendoza, the first Filipino to win Best Director at the Cannes Film Festival. Brillante shows Scott his Manila. At the University of Santo Tomas, he introduces his roots as a production designer. At Mandaluyong, he tells how he eventually became a critically acclaimed filmmaker with "Masahista," a film that won the Golden Leopard at the Locarno Film Festival and "Kinatay," which was feted at Cannes. Brillante reveals his personal side at Quiapo Church and invites Scott to the Secret Garden - his creative sanctuary.
programme.title: Around the World With Voyager

programme.desc: Taipei In Taipei, host photographer Scott Woodward meets Sean Anson Xu, one of the country's most admired and driven entrepreneurs. The son of notable Taiwanese business man Xu Chong Ren, Sean has shot to fame as the affable and passionate restaurateur of Ma Shan Tang, (aka Mazendo). Scott's mission is to shoot 5 definitive portraits of the man around the city, capturing his remarkable life in food and business. Navigating through Taiwan's diverse landscape, Scott takes on a unique and personal visual adventure with his subject.
programme.title: Around the World With Voyager

programme.desc: India The John Walker & Sons Voyager arrives in Mumbai and from there, host and photographer Scott Woodward heads into the desert to Jodhpur where he meets renowned fashion designer Raghavendra Rathore. Born into Jodhpur's royal clan, the Rathores, Raghavendra is famous for making the traditional Rajasthani clothing popular worldwide. While studying at Parsons School of Design, Raghavendra was hand-picked by US fashion designer Donna Karan to be her assistant designer. After another stint with Oscar de la Renta, he returned to Jodhpur where he started his own brand, "Rathore Jodhpur." He remains based in Jodhpur which continues to inspire him.
programme.title: Around the World With Voyager

programme.desc: Mahatma Gandhi A frail man who taught nonviolence, he was a revolutionary the British feared and the leader India followed to independence.
programme.title: Perspectives

programme.desc: Warrior Empire: The Mughals of India From 1526 to 1858, the Mughals, a dynasty of nomadic Asian rulers, created a massive and powerful empire covering much of India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh, passing along an appetite for territory expansion and brutality. But they were also technological innovators and builders of some of the most enduring architecture in South Asia. Through their conquests and achievements, we learn about their military innovations like composite bows, matchlock guns, rocketry, chain mail, and cannons. We explore their feats of archery on horseback and use of elephants as fearsome weapons. And we examine their culture and enduring architecture, including palaces, forts, water systems, gardens, and the Taj Mahal--a tomb that took 22 years to build in honor of the most beloved of the sultan's wives. Join us for a sweeping history of the military ambition, innovative weapons, battle strategies, material excess, architectural wonders, and cultural flowering that shaped modern India.
programme.title: Story Feature

programme.desc: Samurai A look at the world of old Japan and the fighting code of the ruthless Samurai warrior. Discover how their code of honor was born, and the harsh sacrifices they made to live up to their ideals.
programme.title: Ancient Mysteries

programme.desc: Samurai Actor/martial arts champ, Mark Dacascos, explores the story of Miyamoto Musashi, the most famous Samurai of all time, and trains in the weaponry and wisdom of Japan's great warriors. Set to the action-packed, battle-scarred backdrop of Japan's warrior tradition, this new two-hour special takes viewers on an immersive journey through historic Japan in the footsteps of Musashi, Japan's legendary swordsman and warrior. As Mark learns about ancient Samurai culture, the action is brought vividly to life in a dynamic and innovative way through cutting-edge animation.
programme.title: Story Feature

And we examine their culture and enduring architecture, including palaces, forts, water systems, gardens, and the Taj Mahal--a tomb that took 22 years to build in honor of the most beloved of the sultan's wives. Join us for a sweeping history of the military ambition, innovative weapons, battle strategies, material excess, architectural wonders, and cultural flowering that shaped modern India.
programme.title: Story Feature

programme.desc: Samurai A look at the world of old Japan and the fighting code of the ruthless Samurai warrior. Discover how their code of honor was born, and the harsh sacrifices they made to live up to their ideals.
programme.title: Ancient Mysteries

programme.desc: Samurai Actor/martial arts champ, Mark Dacascos, explores the story of Miyamoto Musashi, the most famous Samurai of all time, and trains in the weaponry and wisdom of Japan's great warriors. Set to the action-packed, battle-scarred backdrop of Japan's warrior tradition, this new two-hour special takes viewers on an immersive journey through historic Japan in the footsteps of Musashi, Japan's legendary swordsman and warrior. As Mark learns about ancient Samurai culture, the action is brought vividly to life in a dynamic and innovative way through cutting-edge animation.
programme.title: Story Feature

programme.desc: Vietnam The John Walker & Sons Voyager sails into Halong Bay, Vietnam. From there, host-photographer Scott Woodward travels to the capital, Hanoi, to meet one of the Vietnam's four divas, My Linh. As Vietnam's music ambassador, My Linh's amazing voice has captivated hearts around the world. 2012 marked My Linh's 20th anniversary as an artist and performer - and appropriately, Scott recounts her remarkable life and musical milestones with his camera. From the old neighborhoods of Hanoi to its idyllic countryside and inside its majestic Opera House, My Linh shares her life and world with Scott in an intimate and dramatic fashion.
programme.title: Around the World With Voyager

programme.desc: Hong Kong Scott Woodward meets Stephen Fung Tak Lun, one of Asia's most versatile talents. From acting to directing and music, Stephen has done it all. Scott's mission will be to shoot 5 definitive portraits of Stephen around Hong Kong, capturing his rise through the territory's iconic entertainment industry. As Scott documents Stephen's story on film, he gathers insights on his passion for filmmaking; and how the man transformed himself from an aspiring rock guitarist into a director. Now, he's set on changing the face of Asian cinema for larger audiences.
programme.title: Around the World With Voyager

programme.desc: Manila Host and photographer Scott Woodward photographs filmmaker Brillante Mendoza, the first Filipino to win Best Director at the Cannes Film Festival. Brillante shows Scott his Manila. At the University of Santo Tomas, he introduces his roots as a production designer. At Mandaluyong, he tells how he eventually became a critically acclaimed filmmaker with "Masahista," a film that won the Golden Leopard at the Locarno Film Festival and "Kinatay," which was feted at Cannes. Brillante reveals his personal side at Quiapo Church and invites Scott to the Secret Garden - his creative sanctuary.
programme.title: Around the World With Voyager

programme.desc: Taipei In Taipei, host photographer Scott Woodward meets Sean Anson Xu, one of the country's most admired and driven entrepreneurs. The son of notable Taiwanese business man Xu Chong Ren, Sean has shot to fame as the affable and passionate restaurateur of Ma Shan Tang, (aka Mazendo). Scott's mission is to shoot 5 definitive portraits of the man around the city, capturing his remarkable life in food and business. Navigating through Taiwan's diverse landscape, Scott takes on a unique and personal visual adventure with his subject.
programme.title: Around the World With Voyager

programme.desc: India The John Walker & Sons Voyager arrives in Mumbai and from there, host and photographer Scott Woodward heads into the desert to Jodhpur where he meets renowned fashion designer Raghavendra Rathore. Born into Jodhpur's royal clan, the Rathores, Raghavendra is famous for making the traditional Rajasthani clothing popular worldwide. While studying at Parsons School of Design, Raghavendra was hand-picked by US fashion designer Donna Karan to be her assistant designer. After another stint with Oscar de la Renta, he returned to Jodhpur where he started his own brand, "Rathore Jodhpur." He remains based in Jodhpur which continues to inspire him.
programme.title: Around the World With Voyager

programme.desc: Mahatma Gandhi A frail man who taught nonviolence, he was a revolutionary the British feared and the leader India followed to independence.
programme.title: Perspectives

programme.desc: Warrior Empire: The Mughals of India From 1526 to 1858, the Mughals, a dynasty of nomadic Asian rulers, created a massive and powerful empire covering much of India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh, passing along an appetite for territory expansion and brutality. But they were also technological innovators and builders of some of the most enduring architecture in South Asia. Through their conquests and achievements, we learn about their military innovations like composite bows, matchlock guns, rocketry, chain mail, and cannons. We explore their feats of archery on horseback and use of elephants as fearsome weapons. And we examine their culture and enduring architecture, including palaces, forts, water systems, gardens, and the Taj Mahal--a tomb that took 22 years to build in honor of the most beloved of the sultan's wives. Join us for a sweeping history of the military ambition, innovative weapons, battle strategies, material excess, architectural wonders, and cultural flowering that shaped modern India.
programme.title: Story Feature

programme.desc: Big Brother This episode uncovers the secret surveillance methods the government and big business use to watch, monitor, and record our every move. Government whistleblowers, Thomas Drake and Jesselyn Radack, reveal how the NSA decided to aggressively monitor Americans' correspondence after 9/11. Documentarian Cullen Hoback explains how the government has partnered with Silicon Valley high-tech companies like Facebook and Yahoo to gather data on every American citizen. Journalist Glenn Greenwald describes his first meeting with former NSA contractor Edward Snowden, who claimed that very few of America's surveillance programs have anything to do with 9/11, terrorism, or national security. And former computer hacker Sammy Kamkar explains how someone could watch you from inside your own home. In today's digital age, is the concept of privacy now extinct?
programme.title: America's Book of Secrets

programme.desc: America's Secret Armies They operate in the shadows... men trained to kill... without leaving a trace. But who are these secret forces? What are their covert methods? And, can they be trusted to protect the interests of the American people? Delve into the clandestine operations of the United States' most expertly trained secret weapons. But what exactly are these surreptitious services designed to do--and whom do these stealth-like soldiers ultimately report to? Are the strategies of these covert armies effective in keeping the United States one step ahead of its power hungry enemies? National Security Attorney Mark Zaid reveals details about the prestigious Delta Force unit that have remained a well-kept secret--until now. Former Attorney General John Ashcroft discusses the concept of asymmetrical warfare and how our government employs it today. And author Peter Singer describes the underground war being waged over the internet.
programme.title: America's Book of Secrets

programme.desc: Secret Prisons Go inside the maximum-security world of America's "secret prisons" and unveil their hidden agendas and covert operations. With about one in every one hundred and seven Americans serving time, why are there more people incarcerated in the United States than any where else in the world? Bob Hood, the former Warden at the United States Administrative Maximum Facility reveals what life is like for prisoners inside the gates of what is considered the most secure prison in America. Former inmate Andrew Stepanian reveals details of his lock-up at the Communication Management Unit, a prison that holds some of the country's greatest security threats. Director of the ACLU National Prison Project David Fathi describes the "Kids for Cash" scandal and the under-the-radar Debtors' Prisons. And former Warden Daniel Vasquez explains the big-business surrounding private prisons and FEMA Camps.
programme.title: America's Book of Secrets

programme.desc: The Billionaire Agenda This episode reveals the underground world of America's wealthiest citizens and the depths at which their power and influence take root. Do billionaires think they know better than the majority? Are the American masses just objects to control? Forbes Editor Luisa Kroll talks about the growing wealth of the super-rich and the exclusive billionaire communities that are forming around them. Former United States Secretary of Labor Robert Reich divulges how billionaires' "dark money" influences American politics in ways that are off-limits to public scrutiny. And Author Mark Dice discusses the Bilderberg Group, the world's most secretive society of billionaires and the extreme measures they take to ensure that what happens behind closed doors stays behind closed doors.
programme.title: America's Book of Secrets

programme.desc: The Strange and the Bizarre Recent discoveries of previously unknown hominids and breakthroughs in genetic technology have given a nation of Bigfoot believers new hope that this creature will be found, but what new technologies are being developed for this centuries-old hunt? And, will it ever really be possible to prepare the nation for a cataclysmic event? If doomsday comes, is America really prepared? In 1971, $200,000 went missing in America's only unsolved airplane hijacking. Can following the money help to uncover the true identity of mysterious hijacker D.B. Cooper? Might mainstream science, the government, academic institutions, and even the media all be part of an elaborate conspiracy to keep us from knowing the truth about "The Strange and the Bizarre?
programme.title: America's Book of Secrets: Special Edition

programme.desc: Menaces to Society Some of the most serious threats to life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness lie within America's own borders. Just how dangerous are the hate groups, deadly cults, and violent criminals that lurk in the shadows?
programme.title: America's Book of Secrets: Special Edition

programme.desc: The Kennedy Presidency: History or Hype In a freewheeling town hall discussion at Harvard's Kennedy School of Government, we explore how today's college students view the presidency of John F. Kennedy and how it compares with the traditional view.
programme.title: Story Feature

programme.desc: The JFK Assassination How does forensic science help resolve questions about the JFK assassination? With the help of a group of scientists and researchers with access to the evidence in the case, Investigating History looks at new information.
programme.title: Investigating History

programme.desc: The Kennedy Assassination: 24 Hours After While the moments and hours after JFK's tragic assassination were some of the most formative and important for our country, that story has rarely, and only partially, been told.
programme.title: Story Feature

programme.desc: JFK Assassination: The Definitive Guide September 11th... Pearl Harbor... the assassination of JFK. Days that forever changed America. But the Kennedy assassination is different: 50 years after it happened, most Americans think we don't know who did it.
programme.title: Story Feature

programme.desc: Lee Harvey Oswald: 48 Hours to Live This special seeks to explain the enigmatic Oswald using a brand new approach. No other documentary has exclusively traced Oswald's actions in the minutes, hours, and days following the events in Dallas. By shifting the focus on that November weekend, we're able to tell a familiar story in an unfamiliar way, providing a refreshing new perspective on Oswald himself, as well as on the Kennedy assassination. Ultimately, we will lay bare the suspect's final two days, revealing why the Dallas police were convinced they had Kennedy's killer. On his way to the police station after his arrest at the Texas Theater, an officer asked Oswald whether or not he killed the president. Oswald snidely replied: "You find out for yourself." Lee Harvey Oswald: 48 Hours to Live eagerly takes up Oswald's 50-year-old challenge.
programme.title: Story Feature

programme.desc: S08 E08 Cyprus Stuffed grape leaves and pork belly in Cyprus; curdling goat milk and sampling sun-dried goat; the world's oldest cookie.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods With Andrew Zimmern

programme.desc: S09 E01 Lewis and Clark Trail Andrew follows in the footsteps of Lewis and Clark while experiencing the bountiful cuisine of the Pacific Northwest; sampling Pacific lampreys, forages for edible barnacles and harvests for sea salt on this culinary adventure.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods With Andrew Zimmern

programme.desc: S09 E02 The Southern BBQ Trail Andrew Zimmern eats his way through the Southern BBQ Trail; dry-aged brisket in Atlanta; liver nip dumplings in South Carolina; raccoon hash in Hull, Georgia.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods With Andrew Zimmern

programme.desc: S09 E03 Civil War Andrew Zimmern sinks his teeth into the foods that have sustained soldiers and civilians since the lean times of the Civil War and shaped a region's cuisine, from barbecued raccoon and squirrel stew to tooth-cracking hard tack.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods With Andrew Zimmern

programme.desc: S09 E04 Road Tripping Route 66 Andrew Zimmern sets off on historic Route 66, where he tries ranch dressing soda, judges a calf fry cook-off and dines at some of the most iconic diners along the world-famous highway; quail stew, onion burgers and ox tail.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods With Andrew Zimmern

programme.desc: S09 E05 Great Lakes From pork shoulder cooked underground to hearty pasties and whitefish plucked from the tumultuous Lake Superior, Andrew Zimmern explores the cuisine of the individualistic Upper Peninsula in Michigan.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods With Andrew Zimmern

programme.desc: S09 E06 Cruising the Pacific Coast Highway Andrew Zimmern cruises up the most scenic highway in America on a seafood-sampling adventure; hagfish fishing in the Pacific, eating the slimy reproductive organs of sea urchins and foraging for juicy gooseneck barnacles.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods With Andrew Zimmern

programme.desc: S09 E07 Magnificent Mississippi River Andrew Zimmern follows Mark Twain's path down the Mississippi River for a slice of Americana; floating from meal to meal, he tries frog legs on a cargo ship, hunts wood duck, grills huge fish ribs and learns the art of Deep South pheasant pot pie.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods With Andrew Zimmern

programme.desc: S09 E08 Cajun Country Trail Andrew Zimmern heads south to explore Louisiana's Cajun country; from blood sausage to chewy ginger cakes, seafood gumbo to wild hog heart, Andrew finds that Cajun country is rife with edible resources and French-inspired recipes from the past.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods With Andrew Zimmern

programme.desc: S01 E01 Twin Cities Old-fashioned is combined with modern innovation to create some interesting comfort foods in Minneapolis and St. Paul.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S01 E02 New Orleans Bizarre Foods America visits the Big Easy where the food and the culture are a mix of Southern traditions and modern influence. Andrew eats stuffed pig stomach and smoked raccoon served with a side of live jazz.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S01 E03 Seattle Andrew visits Seattle, where the food scene can be high-tech or ruggedly simple. He's an eyewitness to how complicated gadgets create brand-new tastes, and he visits an all-natural farm to eat cow placenta.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S01 E04 Boston Andrew visits Boston to prove that a traditional city can be a breeding ground for new food trends. He meets a group of Harvard scientists, and a Cambodian family that injects new food traditions into a Boston suburb.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S01 E05 Detroit Andrew finds out if it is food that keeps Detroit's motor running. Andrew visits Motown and gets revved up about tasting some of the city's food, including iconic soul food and lamb brain sandwiches, in the heart of Arab America.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S01 E06 West Virginia West Virginia's culinary delights are celebrated, including fresh deer organs after a kill, groundhog burgoo, and a roadkill cook-off.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S01 E07 Charleston Andrew gets a taste of the rewards from hard work and discovers the true flavor of Charleston's food scene.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S01 E08 Savannah Andrew tastes the cultural influences of the Southern city of Savannah on the sea and dines with The Lady Chablis.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S02 E01 Las Vegas Hamburger that costs five thousand dollars; a seafood restaurant that has an Italian fish market flown in every day; dinner for 1,800 people at Muhammad Ali's 70th birthday.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S02 E02 San Diego From wild vegetables to wild animals, Andrew gets a taste of the unexpected when he visits San Diego.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S02 E03 Miami Andrew Zimmern tracks down the iconic treasures and hidden delights that make Miami's food scene so special.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S02 E04 New Mexico Zimmern explores the many layers of flavors from the past and present that can be found in this southwestern state.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S02 E06 Austin Bloody Mary's made with real blood, whole roasted pigeons, donuts topped with chicken and milkshakes made with bacon.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S02 E07 The Blues Trail Andrew tastes everything from southern staples like smoked baloney sandwiches, deep-fried chicken livers, and pork rinds, to new spins on old staples.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S02 E08 The Other Florida Andrew Zimmern goes deep into the interior of Florida and discovers that people in the rural areas are still living off the land and eating much like their ancestors did.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S03 E01 Washington D.C. Fresh snakehead pulled from the Potomac; pupusas at a Salvadoran restaurant; peanut butter sandwiches made with foie gras.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S03 E02 Denver Rocky Mountain oysters at a ballpark; yak and elk served at an historic restaurant; pheasant cooked outside.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S03 E03 Iowa Andrew Zimmern finds out that there's a lot more than meat and potatoes on the table in Iowa; pork brains with spring onion kimchi; a stew made from a sheep's head.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S03 E04 Alaska's Inside Passage Andrew Zimmern gets a whole new taste of Alaska's Inside Passage. Fresh sea cucumbers; salmon eggs; fish heads.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S03 E05 Wisconsin Science behind what makes milk taste better; a traditional Serbian casserole made with lamb organs; emu testicles.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S03 E06 Chicago's Cutting Edge A fish dish made with ambergris; charcuterie that includes duck heart pate; a soup that smells like a dead body.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S03 E07 Baltimore And Chesapeake Bay Beef tongue sandwiches; Korean soul foods that include boiled pig stomach and blood sausage; traditional bay foods like barbecued muskrat and grilled eel.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S03 E08 The Ozarks Andrew Zimmern makes a trip to the Ozarks where people are still living off the land and making the most of it by combining old traditions with new techniques.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S03 E09 Northern California Andrew visits northern California where people are reinventing the way they look at food. Grilled dove hearts; barf flavored jelly beans; monkey face eel.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S03 E10 Portland Elk heart tartar with a raw turkey egg; bourbon smoked cherries and bone marrow; goose liver with cacao.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S04 E01 Hidden Los Angeles Andrew finds out that some of the best foods in LA are hiding deep inside city neighborhoods; pig head tamales; steamed chicken embryo.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S04 E02 Undiscovered Hawaii Andrew wants to find out what Hawaiians really like to eat; dried octopus bile sac; crispy pork intestine;and a traditional take on a raw fish salad that includes the eyeballs.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S04 E03 Third Coast: Stingrays, Swamp and Swine Andrew visits the forgotten Gulf shore where people strive to preserve their own unique way of life; stingray tacos; pan fried duck testicles; nutria stew.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S04 E04 Queens N.Y.: World's Best Food Town A Pakistani kebab joint with a dish made out of goat liver and brains; a Tibetan place with soup made from yak meat; buffalo chicken feet with maple syrup.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S04 E05 Birmingham: The New South A Chinese style noodle bowl made with frog legs and pig skin; sautéed rabbit offal and goat head soup.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S04 E06 Rhode Island: Chowing Gaggers & Stuffies Andrew visits Rhode Island where old traditions meet the experimental to create clam cakes and monkfish liver mousse.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S04 E07 Louisville: Bourbon And Burgoo Andrew visits Louisville, KY, when he tastes its unique foods; barbecued sheep meat, pork brain sandwiches and burgoo, a hunter's stew made with squirrel.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S04 E08 St. Croix, Usvi: Bull's Feet In Paradise Andrew visits St. Croix in the U.S. Virgin Islands, where he discovers a diverse cultural melting pot of food. Goat water soup; conch roti; breadfruit tostones.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S04 E09 St. Louis: Pig Snouts & Paddlefish Brain sandwiches and crispy pig snouts; pig heart pastrami; dessert made with organ meats and caramel sauce.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S04 E10 Houston: Blast And Cast Andrew Zimmern gets a taste of the vibrant city of Houston. From a tailgating feast featuring buffalo to a blast and cast that nets fresh duck organs and grilled redfish.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S05 E01 New Jersey; Pigs Blood & Paprikash Andrew Zimmern finds out that some amazing things are growing in America's Garden State; dinuguan; Taylor pork roll.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S05 E02 Pittsburgh; Catfish & Kiska Andrew Zimmern discovers that America's Steel City has a knack for blending old and new food traditions.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S05 E03 Virginia, Cicadas & Cownose Rays Andrew Zimmern finds out that in Virginia, people aren't afraid to shake up tradition when it comes to food.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S05 E04 Toronto, Horse Heart & Flipper Pie Andrew finds that Toronto is a melting pot of edgy eats; Horse heart salami; seal flipper pie; pig's ear.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S05 E05 Cleveland Pighead & Perch Andrew Zimmern makes some tasty new discoveries in Cleveland; pig head; kidney ramen; popcorn shoots.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S05 E06 NYC Overnight: Bizarre at All Hours Andrew Zimmern stays up all night in the city that never sleeps to uncover the secrets of feeding hungry New Yorkers.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S05 E07 Minnesota State Fair: Curds, Corn & Cracklins Andrew visits the Minnesota State Fair where bizarre food is the main attraction; Scandinavian delicacy lutefisk; deep-fried candy bars.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S05 E08 San Francisco Bay: Cricket Cookies & Engineered Eggs Andrew Zimmern visits San Francisco's Bay Area; Cookies made with crickets; eggs made out of plants; lamb's head soup.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S06 E01 Alaskan Wilderness: Moose Fat & Muskrat Andrew Zimmern heads into the remote area of Chistochina in Alaska's Copper River Valley; Moose Head Soup.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S06 E02 Vancouver: Box Crabs & Bull Kelp Andrew Zimmern visits Vancouver; Box crab and bull kelp; blood sausage made with pig heads; a tuna cannery.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S06 E03 Nashville: Crane Meat & Pigeon Feet Andrew visits the home of country, Nashville, Tennessee; Hot chicken, dry ribs and grilled Sandhill crane.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S06 E04 Dallas: Red Meat & Rattlesnakes Andrew visits Dallas, Texas; Cow head roasted underground; chicken feet and water bugs; goat meat stew.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S06 E05 Cartagena, Colombia: Jungle Rats & Reptiles Land turtle and shark; land creatures and caiman.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S06 E06 Lima Peru: Frog Shakes & Fish Sperm Frog smoothies; giant Amazonian snails; fried guinea pig; octopus.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S06 E07 Atlanta: Monkfish Liver & Goat Heart Calf brains on toast; grilled goat organs; Korean scrub down.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S06 E08 Florida Keys: Horse Conch and Hogfish Hunting and cooking iguanas with a family; a fishing derby competition; Cuban cooking and cigar making.
programme.title: Bizarre Foods America

programme.desc: S01 E02 Belize Andrew dives into blue waters to encounter sharks and stingrays, and explores a cave filled with skeletons during a trip to Belize.
programme.title: Bizarre World

programme.desc: S29 E11 Fabulous Friendsgiving The Kitchen hosts throw a Friendsgiving party that kicks off with toasted mulled cider margaritas, and baked brie with cranberry chutney and toasted almonds; roasted turkey and root vegetables and mini pumpkin spice latte puddings for dessert.
programme.title: The Kitchen

programme.desc: S35 E03 Turkey Day Mashups The Kitchen goes big on Thanksgiving flavors with mashup favorites! Katie Lee Biegel makes Spinach Artichoke Dip Stuffed Mushrooms, Jeff Mauro preps Jalapeños and Cranberry Stuffed Turkey Breast and Sunny Anderson bakes Adult Pecan Pie Brownie Bars.
programme.title: The Kitchen

programme.desc: S01 E02 Long Island Favorites Danielle Sepsy teams up with her mom to make Pepperoni Stromboli with a flavorful filling and golden crust. Then, Danielle welcomes her grandma to the kitchen to make a Mile High Classic Top-Heavy Deli Crumb Cake with a thick layer of buttery crumbs.
programme.title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy ᴺᵉʷ

programme.desc: S01 E01 Best Sellers Danielle Sepsy shares two items from her bakery, The Hungry Gnome; she makes cherry vanilla bean scones, then bakes blueberry crumb muffins topped with a buttery streusel.
programme.title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy

programme.desc: S02 E01 The Holly Jolly Holiday Tournament Returns Fieri is back to host a holiday showdown in a Winner's Wonderland! programme.title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas

programme.desc: S04 E05 Christmas Games and Music Five cookie makers begin with mix-and-match Christmas character cookies; then the bakers must craft 3D cookie displays inspired by holiday music where they must incorporate ingredients from classic Christmas songs, like pears, figs and chestnuts.

programme.desc: S04 E06 Christmas Is Heating Up Five cookie makers put their heart and soul into crafting cookies that celebrate Christmas weddings; the competition heats up as the cookie makers create 3D Christmas trees inspired by plants found deep in the dessert.
programme.title: Christmas Cookie Challenge

programme.desc: S04 E03 Thanksgiving Turkey Trot In the final qualifier, Jeff Mauro tasks three new teams with crafting a turkey and rider to race in the first annual Turkey Trot; Judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide whose Thanksgiving creations will move on and whose will not.
programme.title: Holiday Wars

programme.desc: S04 E04 Reindeer's New Hobby The six remaining teams face off as Jeff challenges them to envision a hobby for Santa's reindeer to enjoy when they aren't pulling the sleigh; Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira judge the designs before flying one team home.
programme.title: Holiday Wars

programme.desc: S04 E05 Ugly Sweater Party Jeff Mauro challenges the five remaining teams to create a woodland creature that is throwing an ugly sweater party for all its forest friends; at the end of the festive fiesta, judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira eliminate one more team.
programme.title: Holiday Wars

programme.desc: S04 E06 Time Travelin' Santa Jeff Mauro and the Holiday Wars time machine send the remaining four teams back in time; each group must create a Santa from a specific period in history; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move forward.
programme.title: Holiday Wars

programme.desc: S04 E07 A Very Peanuts Christmas Tree Jeff Mauro invites the remaining teams to create a Christmas tree featuring Charles Schulz's beloved Peanuts characters; two teams will face off in the finale for a trip to Iceland.
programme.title: Holiday Wars

programme.title: The Kitchen

programme.desc: S29 E13 Retro Cocktail Party Throwing it back to iconic party bites that deserve a comeback with new twists; fon-duo of taleggio fondue and quick horchata fondue, mini beef wellington bites, and retro rum ginger pomegranate punch.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.title: Roadkill Garage

programme.desc: S03 E08 Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E09 Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E02 Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E03 Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E04 Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E06 Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E07 Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E09 Wild Seafood Risotto Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E10 Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E02 Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E05 The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E08 Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S02 E02 Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E02 The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S02 E05 The Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye It's Steak Day! We're making a Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye; Steak & Eggs; Carne Asada Tacos with Refried Beans and Charred Tomato Salsa; and a Grilled Pork Chop with a Peach Glaze.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E04 These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S02 E03 Every Kind of Rib: Dino, Fried, Smoked, Grilled and Glazed It's Rib Day on BBQ Smokeout! programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E03 Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E01 Beef Shank is the New Brisket Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E05 The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S05 E03 Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E06 Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E07 Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E09 Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E10 Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E01 The Best Fish You're Not Eating Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E02 Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E03 The Most Underrated Game Bird Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E04 How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E06 Game Day Fried Squab Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E07 The Wild Boar Playbook Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E10 The Ultimate Elk Tailgate It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E04 Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E09 Wild Seafood Risotto Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E10 Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E01 Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S07 E02 Cajun-Style Grilled Wild Turkey & Creamy Tetrazzini Andrew gives holiday turkey the Wild Game Kitchen treatment with grilled turkey tetrazzini and a butter basted Cajun-spiced whole bird roasted over crawfish, andouille and cornbread stuffing.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S07 E05 Venison Satay & Classic Venison Wellington Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S01 E03 Crispy Rolled Pork Belly and Risotto Jamie shares more fabulous one-pan dishes: foolproof tray-baked salmon in a bag; super-easy tomato fritters that you can rattle out in a frying pan; and roasted rolled pork and a risotto that are BOTH cooked in the same casserole pan. Result!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders

programme.desc: S01 E01 Weeknight Roast Lamb and Eggplant Jamie kicks off his new one-pan series with a simplified and delicious frying-pan pasta, a clever twist on a fish pie that's full of flavour with none of the fuss, and a sublime roast lamb feast with a fantastic hack to speed up cooking.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders

programme.desc: S01 E08 An Eggplant Burger, Seared Salmon, & Squash Casserole! Jamie shares three easy one-pan wonders: an aubergine burger, sesame salmon, and chickpea & squash casserole!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders

programme.desc: S01 E02 Speedy Chicken and Mushroom Puff Pastry Pie Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes that provide a perfect solution for busy life: a superfast, flavour-packed smoky noodle soup; the cleverest homemade bread in a pan; and a chicken & mushroom pie with a time-saving tip for perfect pastry.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders

programme.desc: S01 E07 Salmon Pasta, a Loaded Burger, and Sticky Toffee Apple Buns! Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes: smoked salmon pasta, a loaded beef burger, and sticky toffee apple buns.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders

programme.desc: S01 E05 Sweet Potato Chilli and Homemade Nachos Jamie shows us a delicious range of one-pan dishes: a super-speedy smashed lemongrass chicken; flavour-packed sweet potato chilli with homemade nachos; and a chocolate party tray cake with retro tinned-mandarin and buttercream filling.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders

programme.desc: S01 E06 Jamie's Outrageously Good Pulled Pork Jamie cooks two one-pan recipes that are ideal for busy lives: his take on shakshuka with asparagus, broccoli & harissa; and an outrageously good pulled pork that can be batched up, frozen and used in loads of meals whenever you're ready.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders

programme.desc: S01 E04 Not Your Nonna's Gnocchi and Meatballs In this episode Jamie takes midweek meals up a notch, knocking out a flavour-packed, simple gnocchi supper and giant spicy meatballs full of delicious time-saving cheats, and turns a family favourite on its head with his upside-down fish pie.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders

programme.desc: S01 E01 Crispy Pork Noodles and Cheesy Chard Cannelloni Jamie celebrates rhubarb in a lip-smacking sauce, heroes spinach in a silky goat's cheese risotto and marries vibrant basil with chard in a crowd-pleasing cheesy spring cannelloni.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E02 Spring Onion Chicken Curry and Sausage Broccoli Pizza Jamie elevates asparagus spears for a fishy feat, makes spring onions the star of the show in his spicy green chicken curry and gives purple sprouting broccoli an Italian-inspired makeover.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E03 Stuffed Salmon Celebration and Almond Custard Tart Jamie snazzes up some spuds with wild garlic pesto, creates a broad bean mezze, rustles up a beautiful spring salad and honours rhubarb in a luscious custard tart with almond brittle.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E04 Summer-y Sweet Pea Risotto and Slow Roasted Pork Jamie celebrates summer with roasted fennel pork & gratin, oozy pea risotto, and rainbow slaw chicken wraps. He shares edible hanging basket tips. The feast finishes with stunning mackerel on sun-dried tomato couscous with colorful beets.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E05 Buddy's Strawberry Rice Pudding and Summer Tomato Chicken Bake Jamie cooks a chicken sheet pan dinner with early tomatoes, potatoes and chorizo. Buddy helps pick strawberries for quick jam rice pudding. The summer feast ends with spicy shrimp skewers with homegrown chillies and a refreshing cucumber gazpacho.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E06 Endless Summer: From Grilled Panzanella Salad to Sour Cherry Tart Jamie ends summer with crispy duck in a rich plum sauce & roast potatoes. Grilled peppers star in panzanella. Garden zucchini become Mediterranean rice. Sweet finale: sour cherry frangipane with crème fraîche.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E07 Jamie's ULTIMATE Autumn Garden FEAST! Jamie kicks off autumn with Italian-inspired cheesy cabbage pasta and smoky sweetcorn burgers with feta. He shares tips for storing onions and saving tomato seeds, finishing with a beautiful tomato galette for a perfect fall meal.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E08 Autumn's Harvest: Roast Chicken and Tarte Tatin Jamie cooks a roast chicken with eggplant, bakes feta with figs & prosciutto, and creates a runner bean stew with fish. He shares tips for storing berries and chiles, finishing with a stunning pear tarte tatin.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E10 Jamie Makes the World's Best Christmas Lasagne Jamie throws the most festive Christmas Party! The menu includes cheesy filo parcels, a make-ahead Christmas cauliflower lasagne, and jerk-rubbed hasselback root veg with chicken kebabs. He finishes with a fudgy sticky toffee coffee pudding.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E11 Jamie's Show-Stopping Christmas Porchetta Jamie welcomes his family to his outdoor shed for Christmas dinner! programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E05 The Art of the Egg Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E07 The Famous Pastes of Spices Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E08 Mayan Gateway To The Underworld No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E09 Yucatán's Most Unique Salts An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E10 A Mayan League of their Own In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E09 A Day With Hugo Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E06 Yucatán Meats Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E01 The Nectar of the Mayan Gods Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E03 The Best Tacos In Mérida Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: E3 A miraculous mantle envelops the entire planet - a thin skin of gasses called 'air'. Without it, there would be no life or weather, no habitable conditions, or protection from lethal ultraviolet radiation or meteorites from outer space.
programme.title: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet

programme.desc: E1 It's the solid crust of our planet, the perfect element in which to record the stories of deep time and of lifetimes. Change and progression is the way of earth. Air and water turn solid rock into soil.
programme.title: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet

programme.desc: E2 How the flow of water has the power to shape all inhabitants on Earth, produces climate-changing weather and supporting species, from the largest whales to microscopic plankton.
programme.title: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet

programme.desc: E1 Arid and unforgiving, deserts push their inhabitants to the extreme; from the desert elephant to the shovel-snouted lizard, see how they survive.
programme.title: Wild Kingdoms

programme.desc: E2 Rivers are the life veins of this planet, offering all those that depend on them respite from both heat and thirst; a look into how for the life they give, they also take away.
programme.title: Wild Kingdoms

programme.desc: E3 Africa's rainforests are second only to the Amazon in size; see these tangled worlds, that are home to chimpanzees, gorillas and forest elephants, one of the last remaining strongholds for the planet's wild creatures.
programme.title: Wild Kingdoms

programme.desc: E1 Plants are communicating, helping each other thrive; staying aware of their surroundings by using dozens of highly sensitive sensors, plants are sending signals, even across species.
programme.title: Nature's Hidden Miracles

programme.desc: E2 In order to adapt to different environments, protect themselves from enemies, obtain food, and reproduce, insects have become highly specialized; they transform themselves into completely different creatures, changing their habitat and even food.
programme.title: Nature's Hidden Miracles

programme.desc: E3 Microorganisms are the rulers and guardians of Earth.
programme.title: Nature's Hidden Miracles

programme.desc: E1 Between five and 10 million different kinds, maybe ten quintillion individuals; insects live the most extraordinary lives, many of them revealed for the first time in this one-hour program.
programme.title: Planet Insect

programme.desc: E2 Insects are very good at making more insects, but it's not easy; insects are tiny creatures living in a big world; partners must find each other to mate, and the next generation must survive in a huge, dangerous world.
programme.title: Planet Insect

programme.desc: E3 Social insects - ants, bees, wasps, and termites - are incredibly successful; by some estimates, the weight of ants equals that of humanity, and that of termites equals terrestrial vertebrates.

programme.desc: S07 E05 I'm Telling You Im Dangerous In rural Missouri, police receive a haunting call from a 50-year-old man claiming he shot three people inside his home. Detectives uncover that this impulsive massacre has a motive and that the killer is a psychopath obsessed with control.
programme.title: Signs of a Psychopath

programme.desc: S07 E08 I Am the Weirdest Guy A mother awakes to find her two sons with their throats cut; their aunt's boyfriend confesses to his mother, and she wears a wire to capture her son; as he admits his guilt, it's clear how a psychopathic rage led to violence.
programme.title: Signs of a Psychopath

programme.desc: S08 E06 My Pretty White Shoelaces Hikers in Portland discover the badly decomposed body of a raped and strangled young girl; A month later, another woman turns up brutally murdered in same fashion; the prime suspect is a homeless drifter harboring dark sexual fantasies.
programme.title: Signs of a Psychopath

programme.desc: S07 E07 Make Sure You Get My Good Side A road rage incident turns deadly as an elderly man is beaten to death by a teenager who claims he was acting in self-defense; detectives not only find holes in his story but uncover that he is a remorseless and manipulative psychopath.
programme.title: Signs of a Psychopath

programme.desc: S08 E03 Unorthodox and Weird A 19-year-old woman vanishes, and the suspect is a former high school classmate with whom she had been communicating days earlier. The family is weary, for the suspect has a notorious past filled with sexual deviancy and homicidal urges toward women.
programme.title: Signs of a Psychopath

programme.desc: S02 E03 Deadly Delivery A successful Florida family has their American dream shattered when a mysterious figure dressed as a clown shoots a loving mother on her doorstep; the case goes cold for decades until an unexpected break helps bring the killer clown to justice.
programme.title: Married to Evil

programme.desc: S02 E06 Dying to Leave After years of abuse, Cheryl musters the courage to leave her husband, Thom; he stalks her and torments their two children; when Cheryl finds a new love, her ex sets a trap to take the ultimate revenge.
programme.title: Married to Evil

programme.desc: S02 E05 Out of Control When Angie meets Joe, her family and friends aren't sure what to make of their relationship; the couple marry and have kids, but soon Angie becomes isolated from her loved ones and trapped in a spiral of abuse that ends in a horrific triple homicide.
programme.title: Married to Evil

programme.desc: S02 E02 Home Is Where the Nightmare Is Jenny and Mike are teen sweethearts but after marrying, Mike begins a campaign of control and violence against his wife and children; just as Jenny plans to escape her living nightmare, Mike finds out and decides he will do anything to stop her.
programme.title: Married to Evil

programme.desc: S03 E05 Four Weddings and a Funeral After four marriages, 36-year-old Carol Grannon returns to school and lands a lucrative job; sadly, one of the men in her life will end it just as she begins this new chapter.
programme.title: Betrayed

programme.title: Betrayed

programme.desc: S03 E08 Beware the Au Pair When 34-year-old mother Tara Lynn Grant goes missing, police can find no trace of her until a gruesome discovery turns the case into a statewide manhunt.
programme.title: Betrayed

programme.desc: After 25 years at the Late Night desk, Conan realized that the only people at his holiday party are the men and women who work for him. Over the years and despite thousands of interviews, Conan has never made a real and lasting friendship with any of his celebrity guests. So, he started a show to do just that. Deeper, unboundedly playful, and free from FCC regulations, Conan O'Brien Needs a Friend is an opportunity for Conan to hang out with the people he enjoys most and perhaps find some real friendship along the way.
programme.title: Conan O'Brien Needs A Friend
